title: User Interaction Methods and Digital Interactivity

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of user interaction methods — touch, voice, gesture, keyboard, mouse, eye tracking — and how digital interactivity shapes the user experience.

items.title: Graphical User Interfaces: Crash Course Computer Science #26
items.description: Traces the history of user interaction from punched cards to touchscreens — a compelling overview of how interaction methods have evolved.

items.title: 100+ Computer Science Concepts Explained — Fireship
items.description: Rapid-fire coverage of input/output, event-driven programming, and UI patterns — great for reinforcing the interaction concepts in this lesson.

items.title: Bret Victor — Inventing on Principle
items.description: A visionary talk on how new interaction paradigms are invented — inspires thinking about what digital interactivity could look like beyond today's norms.

items.title: Black Mirror (2011)
items.description: Anthology series exploring how future interaction methods — implants, holograms, haptics — reshape society. Thought-provoking context for where UX is heading.

items.title: Material Design — Gestures
items.description: Google's official guide to gesture-based interaction on Android — shows how real-world platforms implement touch and gesture input methods.

items.title: Apple — Human Interface Guidelines
items.description: Apple's definitive guide to interaction design across iOS and macOS — covers touch, voice, pointer, and keyboard interaction methods in depth.

items.title: OCR Cambridge Nationals IT — Specification at a Glance
items.description: Check the user interaction and digital interactivity content in the OCR J836 spec to ensure you cover everything the exam requires.
